_comment: HywMill culture squads (post-M5), sold on the Muster Roll's Squads tab. Per culture 16 squads: 6 infantry (2 LOW, 2 MEDIUM, 2 HIGH), 4 ranged, 4 cavalry (cultures without horses get fast foot bands instead), 2 unique; 8-12 soldiers each. A member is a unit key from hywmill_garrison/units.json (plus lancer_rider), a count, a gear tier (the profile tier and HYW equipment level it is equipped at) and an optional kit ('levy': light gambeson kits). Quality sets the default requirements: LOW Trusted, MEDIUM Patron and a Guard Post village, HIGH Sworn and a Garrison village ('standing' and 'village' override). The price is the sum of the members' Muster Roll prices less 'squadDiscount', then the standing discount. No siege engines. Cultures are replaced whole by later files; 'defaults' serves unknown cultures. 'look' names the squad's look (hywmill_equipment/squad_looks.json); 'livery': 'village' marks a generic squad, raised from the village itself: it keeps its look's armour but wears the hiring village's colours and arms.
